gen-fs-bevellier-gf-mada: Mada has curves that refuse to close and a towering midzone, a friendly counterweight to the flat, stencil-cut look of Bevellier. Because its midzone is so tall, Mada can go a touch smaller.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-mozilla-headline: Big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal make the text approachable, while Bevellier stays flat and stencil-cut with no swelling where curves meet stems. Mozilla Headline should carry paragraph after paragraph with a relaxed, contemporary ease.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: A welcoming gap in the c and capitals barely above lowercase make the text feel clean and modern. Noto Kufi Arabic supplies the quiet sentences while Bevellier, drawn like bent pipe, does the dressing up.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-glagolitic: Flat and stencil-cut, with signage-like plainness in every line weight, Bevellier is tightly spaced. Noto Sans Glagolitic supplies sturdy lowercase and round forms that read clearly small, which is the whole appeal.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Marker tip meets glass bead: Bevellier is drawn as if with a marker, while Noto Sans Gothic hollows out big lowercase counters. Over paragraphs it reads smoothly, round forms like open parentheses.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-go: Dowel stems meet crayon-thick marks: Bevellier builds its heading from straight and bent dowels, flat and stencil-cut. And Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi leaves big gaps at its cut-back terminals, loosening the text beneath.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-hk: Bevellier draws with the steady line of a technical drafting pen. Noto Sans HK, with big lowercase and brush ends lifted before the curve closes, loosens that precision for the text beneath.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-jp: Flat and stencil-cut up top, Bevellier keeps every arm and leg at a constant width. But Noto Sans JP, with a very tall x-height, plus curves that sweep open, is the distinctive part.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-kr: Stencil-cut flatness defines Bevellier, down to a y whose tail matches its arm in thickness. Noto Sans KR responds with generous curve gaps and stubby ascenders and descenders beside a tall-bodied lowercase.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Gaping curves and tall-bodied small letters make Noto Sans Limbu open and approachable, a contemporary text face with room to spare. Bevellier does the wire-lined display work, Noto Sans Limbu the sustained reading.
